Glamping on Wine

Brand Identity, Narrative, Web Design

Glamping on Wine brings together places to stay at wineries and vineyards. We developed its identity and website around the setting.

Visit Glamping on Wine

Scope

Sleeping among the vines was the premise. We approached the identity as a wine brand, with the landscape doing much of the work.

Brand Identity

A restrained wordmark and palette leave space for the photography. The imagery establishes the mood of a stay before the site introduces its practical details.

Web Experience

The site leads with the properties and their surroundings. Booking follows a short sequence: choose a property, choose dates, confirm.
